blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — While it remains officially classified as a first-class municipality, this central trading hub outpaced the province’s lone component city in local revenue generation for fiscal year 2025, according to official financial data published by the Bureau of Local Government Finance (BLGF). The figures stem from the complete 2025 Statement of Receipts and Expenditures (SRE) datasets uploaded by the BLGF central office on June 30, 2026, following the annual consolidation and auditing of local treasury reports nationwide. The localized rankings across the Caraga region were compiled and publicized by regional data tracker Growing Mindanao on Thursday, […]...
